description: same_person — the groom persona G1 scored against the John Flynn tree stub that was minted FROM G1 in this same run. The comparison is circular: both documents descend from one persona, so the high score is self-confirmation and carries no independent information. The fixture exists because the harness answered this call with `fixture_not_found`, which the judge read as a critical tool-usage error and failed the test on (ut_person_evidence_n7v, v1_2026-08-27_12-36-32 and v1_2026-09-21_20-54-41). The test's own judge_context says the groom half needs no same_person call and must not be penalised either way, so an optional call must not hard-fail the run. The agent body forbids the call (agents/person-evidence.md, 'Do not score a stub you minted from the persona you would be scoring'); this fixture makes that a graded judgement rather than a harness error.
